description:
FILED s431 (Opus 5) while classifying t/re/pat.t:106 for the P1 flip census.

PROBES (perl 5.40.3 all print `ok:1:d` then AFTER; `sub ok {...}` declared above, $_ = 'aaaccc'):

    ok /a/,   "d";   PCL right
    ok /a*/,  "d";   PCL: runtime type-error -- (P-REGEX "/, \"d\";\nprint ...") : the regex literal swallowed the rest of the file
    ok /a+/,  "d";   same
    ok /a?/,  "d";   PCL: statement DROPPED, reason `Ternary operator: Found '?' but no matching ':'`, and the FOLLOWING statement is inside the dropped text

CAUSE: `_repair_word_match` finds the opening `/` and then searches forward for a CLOSING `Operator(/)`.  With a quantifier PPI does not produce one -- `ok /a*bc*/` tokenizes as Operator(/) Word(a) Symbol(*bc) Operator(*) Regexp::Match("/, ... rest of file"), i.e. the closing slash has already been absorbed into a Regexp::Match token that runs to EOF.  `$close` stays 0, the repair declines, and the mis-lex reaches PExpr.

OWNS the census row t/re/pat.t:106 (`ok /a*b?c*/, qq [...]`) -- one of the 31 genuine gaps of the s431 census.

FIX SHAPE: widen the closing-delimiter search to accept the absorbed forms (a following Regexp::Match token whose content STARTS with `/` is the closing slash plus the rest), or decide the shape from the opening `/` alone once the Word is known not to be a term.  Keep the section-11 `<` guard and the `_word_is_term` negative.

BAR: the four probes above + the inverse (`map { ... } <op/*>` from section 11; `sub g () {...} print g /2/` division) vs perl; gate-SET scan over both populations (a repair that fires MORE widens a checker); corpus-diff; guard rows.
subject: `_repair_word_match` (PPI section 11) DECLINES when the pattern carries a quantifier: `ok /a*/, "d"` mis-compiles to DIVISION (crash) and `ok /a?/, "d"` drops with a bogus ternary error, swallowing the NEXT statement
